item.title: [UI & Layout] Smart Feature Grid Layout
item.description: AI agents often default to visually weak 'emoji feature cards' that fail to convey value. This pattern replaces those with a conversion-focused, scannable grid that highlights benefits and avoids generic iconography, driving clearer understanding and engagement. | Fonts: Inter Bold + IBM Plex Sans Text | Palette: #2E3A4B #F0F4F8 #4CAF50 #8C9BA8 | Prompt: For an AI coding agent: Generate a responsive 3-column feature grid. item.description: Single, bold letterforms dominate high-impact branding due to their immediate recognition and versatility.
